answer_1.quote: We propose a multitasking framework SimpDefiner to generate simple definitions ... The framework consists of a fully shared encoder and two partially shared decoders ... The SDG task is to generate a simple definition d_sim for a given word and context (w*, c).

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU ... Semantic Similarity ... SARI ... to evaluate the generated definitions.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 200 words and contexts ... three native‑speaker annotators to score them. Specifically, each annotator evaluates the definitions on two criteria of accuracy and simplicity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each definition on accuracy (semantic relevance) and simplicity on a 1–3 scale.
